vision.name: Majin Denial
vision.text:
([Trait:Majin] only. Limit 1 per deck. Once per combat, you may shuffle this card from your hand into your Life Deck as an action to Rejuvenate 3.)
POWER: Destroy a Drill. [Warning]: Destroy all Drills instead.
(Banish after use.)
